objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-impair-defenses-disable-av-autostart-via-registry
objects.description: The following analytic detects modifications to the registry related to the disabling of autostart functionality for certain antivirus products, such as Kingsoft and Tencent. Malware like ValleyRAT may alter specific registry keys to prevent these security tools from launching automatically at startup, thereby weakening system defenses.
